meta.title: Living icons
meta.description: Adds a 'Living icons' section to Settings with switches for the hover motion of UI icons and the spinning thinking icon while a reply is reasoning. There is no icon gallery tab in the session header. Each glyph plays one short motion on hover and settles when the pointer leaves; idle icons never animate, so it costs nothing. Respects prefers-reduced-motion. Preferences are local to the browser; nothing is read from or sent to sessions.
